posts.title: What’s in a name? D. B. Keele, Jr.?
posts.description: What’s in a name? Some readers have commented that they felt I was a bit pretentious for only listing my initials in the byline of my reviews (D. B. Keele, Jr.) In this case I have a very good reason and a good story to go along with it. My full legal name is D. […]
